outcome: Frequency of clinical symptoms (headache, vision changes, seizures, consciousness disorders)
Blood pressure measurements (systolic, diastolic, mean arterial pressure)
cohort: 100 pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia or eclampsia who underwent brain MRI.
finding: RPLS was observed in 0.22% of pregnant women, and was significantly associated with increased frequency of clinical symptoms, higher blood pressure, specific brain MRI findings (primarily affecting the occipital lobe), higher cesarean section rates, and lower Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate in the RPLS group was higher than the non-RPLS group (P<0.05).
